facts.claim: Sea Cloud (Sea Cloud Cruises): Entered service 1931; 2,531 GT; 64 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 109 m length; Tall Ship class.
Sea Cloud is a sailing cruise ship owned by Sea Cloud Cruises of Hamburg, Germany.
After the war, Sea Cloud was returned to private ownership, serving as a yacht for numerous people, including as presidential yacht of the Dominican Republic.
Since 1979, Sea Cloud has been used as a cruise ship.

catalogSpecs.description: Historic four-masted barque offering luxury tall-ship cruises.
